plan.device_policy: CPU64 preflight first; original native256 CUDA FP32, four draws/batch, channels-last, same original benchmark-enabled inference setup. At most16GiB CUDA allocator and24GiB available-system-memory reserve.
plan.coverage: All448 original observations:24 carriers+4 flats across4CFAs/4draws;112 batches. CPU preflight is separate64px hook/state engineering, no quality conclusion.
plan.intervention: Capture final directional-module inputs/output after the unchanged trunk. Require exact full replay and model-output identity. For bank-logits-zero, execute bank normally then replace only its output by zeros, preserving module presence and candidate order.
plan.interpretation_limits: Inference contributions at fixed trained weights only, not independently retrained effects. No target/frequency enters model forward, no model/metric/threshold selection, new checkpoint/default, training update, old-budget extension, full-frame/export/speed or protected-final score.

diagnostic.scope: Fixed trained weights, paired original CPU observations, final-module replay and bank-output-zero intervention. The base uses the same trunk return-features path. Effects are conditional inference contributions, not independently retrained architecture effects or new restoration-quality/promotion evidence. Known carrier frequency enters scoring only.

scope: Independent saved-scalar coverage/arithmetic/replay and file-SHA checks only. Model replay and tensor-state identity were asserted by the separately executed diagnostic, not recomputed here. Contrasts are differences of metrics at fixed trained weights, not metrics of isolated component images, independent retraining effects, scene confidence intervals, or training-gradient causes. No new training/checkpoint/default or quality promotion.
